info.title: UACRF journey and shared resource catalogue
info.description: Catalogue contract revision 1 with ten local runtime handlers in runtime/. Live provider, connected product UI and full-system acceptance remain pending. Catalogue membership does not grant runtime authority.

get.description: Authenticate tenant/environment, current purpose, disclosure and capability permissions before every read or mutation. Derive actor and environment on the server. Paginate after authorization, never expose hidden counts. Separate aggregate access from service/agent permissions; report only authorized visible scope. Mutations use the existing durable idempotent command admission, then commit catalogue row, audit and outbox atomically. Responses confirm metadata only, never runtime success. Opaque continuation cursors bind current tenant, environment, target, filters and disclosure policy. Validate and decode before SQL binding; an invalid or stale cursor is restrictive, never silently reused.
